items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Joe Conduo was a volunteer. I knew him from before.

ctx.x: to the park a long time. Well you left on the train together with him?

Yeah, yeah, we left on the train together. Just the two of you? Yeah. We went up there on the train and we got to New York, I tell you when we got to New York on New Year's Eve night, I think we got to New York, and we moved right in with Sharky because we knew when Sharky was up there, we moved in with him. And that same night, I think it was New Year's Eve we got there, I think. Joe Conduo was a volunteer. I knew him from before. He worked in a club right on 48th Street there, some club, I can't tell you the…
How long before you started work with Wayne Eaton?
